spans.s: ह्वे vt. or vi. 1U (pp. हूत; pres. ह्वयति-ते; pass. हूयते; caus. ह्वाययति-ते; desid. जुहूषति-ते) 1. To call, तां पार्वतीत्याभिजनेन नाम्ना बंधुप्रियां बंधुजनो जुहाव K.S.i.26; 2. to call upon, to invoke; 3. to challenge; 4. to name; 5. to emulate, to vie with; 6. to ask to beg.With आ-, 1. to call, to invite, M.iii.27; 2. (Atm.) to challenge, द्यामिवाह्वयमानं तमवोचद्भूधरं कपिः Bt.viii.18.With सम्-, to call out together.
